title: A hold is a fence now, not a switch

text: A minion declares the files it is writing, and only those are held; your own saves anywhere else reload you at once — proven: a change on AI 2 reloaded its tab in half a second while a held change on the old board reached nobody. The dev bar says exactly what is held. With the earlier fix (215 reloads a day, 203 for nothing), the reload problem is closed.
